title: Resolution resetting Fiscal 2027 property tax rates and levy
summary: This resolution amends and restates the Council's prior resolution fixing real property tax rates for Fiscal Year 2027, following a state law change allowing the city to adjust the cap on how much any property tax class's share can grow, now set at 0.3 percent. It sets the total tax levy at $39,885,078,591 to raise $37,190,000,000 net toward the $125,841,596,044 Fiscal 2027 budget, and fixes new tax rates by property class, including 0.19972 for one-, two- and three-family homes. The Council plans to adopt this alongside related base proportion resolutions on November 12, 2026.
